name: add_variable_mode
title: Add variable mode
description: Adds a mode to a local variable collection. Returns { modeId, collection } with the collection as in get_variable_collections. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the mode name is taken in this collection.

name: create_annotation_category
title: Create annotation category
description: Adds an annotation category to the file. Returns { id, label, color, isPreset }. INVALID_ARGUMENT if a category with the label exists or the color is not one of Figma's.

name: get_annotation_categories
title: Get annotation categories
description: Returns the annotation categories of the file: [{ id, label, color, isPreset }].

name: set_node_annotations
title: Set node annotations
description: Replaces the annotations of one category on a layer with the given notes (Markdown); [] removes them. Annotations of other categories stay. Returns { id, name, annotations }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown layer or category; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that cannot have annotations.

notes.description: Annotation texts, Markdown; [] — remove this category's annotations

name: clone_node
title: Clone node
description: Copies a layer with its children (node.clone()). By default the copy goes right after the original in the same parent; parentId / index put it elsewhere (index — its place among the parent's children, the end by default). Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). Plus copies: [{ source, id, name }] — every layer of the copy against its original, in tree order, the copy itself first (in run_batch: saves "copies[2].id"). NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page, a component or component set, a layer inside an instance, a parent that cannot have children, an index out of range.

parentId.description: Parent of the copy: a page or a layer with children; the original's parent by default

index.description: Place of the copy among the parent's children; right after the original by default

name: create_effect_style
title: Create effect style
description: Creates a local effect style, optionally with shadows and blurs as in set_effect_style_effects. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. INVALID_ARGUMENT if an effect style already has the name or an effect is invalid; NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable; nothing is created then.

color.description: "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } of a COLOR variable

x.description: Offset x in px or { variableId } of a FLOAT variable

y.description: Offset y in px or { variableId }

radius.description: Blur radius in px (>= 0) or { variableId }
Blur radius in Figma units (>= 0; CSS blur() is half of it) or { variableId } of a FLOAT variable

effects.description: Shadows and normal blurs in Figma array order: the LAST one is on top (top of the Figma panel); shadows get blendMode NORMAL, showShadowBehindNode false

name: create_frame
title: Create frame
description: Creates a frame in a parent: vertical auto layout without spacing, hugging its children, no fill by default. Optional layout (auto-layout settings), fills/strokes (paint lists), strokeWeight and cornerRadius are validated and built BEFORE the frame is created — on any error nothing is created. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, an index out of range, or bad layout/paint values.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

layout.description: Auto-layout settings to apply right after creation

fills.description: Fill paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

name: set_frame_layout
title: Set frame layout
description: Sets auto-layout settings on a frame, component or instance: direction, itemSpacing, padding, axis sizing/alignment, wrap. Enables auto layout (VERTICAL) when the node had none. Everything is validated BEFORE anything is applied — on error the file does not change. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that cannot have auto layout (a group — convert it to a frame first) or bad values.

name: set_node_fills
title: Set node fills
description: Replaces a node's fills with a paint list (SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, GRADIENT_LINEAR/RADIAL with hex stops), or clears them with clear: true. Paints are fully built and validated BEFORE assignment — on error fills stay untouched. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } + paints count. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node without fills, bad paint input or a non-COLOR variable.

paints.description: Fill paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

clear.description: true removes all fills; cannot be combined with paints

name: set_node_strokes
title: Set node strokes
description: Replaces a node's strokes with a paint list (same shape as set_node_fills), optionally setting strokeWeight and strokeAlign. Paints are fully built and validated BEFORE assignment — on error strokes stay untouched. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } + paints count. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node without strokes or bad paint/stroke values.

paints.description: Stroke paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

clear.description: true removes all strokes; cannot be combined with paints

name: set_node_corner_radius
title: Set node corner radius
description: Sets the corner radius: one number for all corners or per-corner { topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft }. All values are validated BEFORE applying. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node without a corner radius (or without per-corner radii) or negative values.

name: set_node_size
title: Set node size
description: Resizes a node (width/height, keeps the unset axis) and/or sets its layout sizing per axis: FIXED, HUG or FILL. Figma rules are checked BEFORE applying: HUG only on an auto-layout frame or a text node, FILL only inside an auto-layout parent — on violation nothing changes. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a non-resizable node or broken sizing rules.

name: set_node_layout_child
title: Set node layout child
description: Sets how a node behaves as a child: layoutGrow (0/1), layoutAlign (INHERIT/STRETCH) and layoutPositioning (AUTO/ABSOLUTE) inside an auto-layout parent; constraints (horizontal/vertical) for nodes in a plain frame. The parent is checked BEFORE applying. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT when the parent is not auto layout (for layout* fields) or the node has no constraints.

name: create_rectangle
title: Create rectangle
description: Creates a rectangle in a parent with width/height, optional fills/strokes/strokeWeight/cornerRadius. Paints are built BEFORE the node is created — on any error nothing is created. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, bad size or paint.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

fills.description: Fill paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

strokes.description: Stroke paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

name: create_ellipse
title: Create ellipse
description: Creates an ellipse in a parent with width/height, optional fills/strokes/strokeWeight. Paints are built BEFORE the node is created — on any error nothing is created. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, bad size or paint.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

fills.description: Fill paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

strokes.description: Stroke paints: SOLID with hex or a bound COLOR variable, or gradients

color.description: SOLID only: "#rrggbb"/"#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } to bind a COLOR variable

stops.description: Gradient stops (hex colors only — variables bind to SOLID paints)

angle.description: GRADIENT_LINEAR direction in degrees: 0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom

name: apply_style
title: Apply style
description: Applies a local style to a node by target: fill/stroke (a PAINT style), text (a TEXT style, text nodes only) or effect (an EFFECT style). The style type must match the target — checked BEFORE applying. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } + styleId/styleName/styleType/target. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or style; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a type mismatch or a node that cannot take the target.

name: bind_node_variable
title: Bind node variable
description: Binds a variable to a node field, or unbinds with variableId: null. Color fields fills/strokes bind a COLOR variable to the FIRST paint of the array (it must exist and be SOLID). Float fields (a FLOAT variable): width, height, itemSpacing, paddingTop/paddingRight/paddingBottom/paddingLeft, topLeftRadius/topRightRadius/bottomRightRadius/bottomLeftRadius, fontSize (text nodes only). All checks run BEFORE binding. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } + field/variableId/variableName. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a wrong field, type mismatch or a missing/non-SOLID first paint.

field.description: fills/strokes bind the first paint (COLOR variable); the rest bind a number property (FLOAT variable)

variableId.description: Variable id, or null to unbind

name: create_component_from_node
title: Create component from node
description: Turns an existing node into a component, keeping its auto layout, bound variables and styles as they are. Optional name renames the result. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page, an instance or a node inside an instance (detach it first).

name.description: New component name; the node name is kept by default

name: create_component
title: Create component
description: Creates an empty component in a parent, optionally resized and positioned. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, an index out of range or a bad size — nothing is created then.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

name: create_component_set
title: Create component set
description: Combines existing components into a variant set inside a parent (figma.combineAsVariants). Every id is checked to be a COMPONENT BEFORE combining — on error nothing changes. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } of the COMPONENT_SET. NOT_FOUND for an unknown component or parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a non-component id, a parent that cannot have children or an index out of range.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

componentIds.description: Ids of the COMPONENT nodes to combine, in variant order

name: set_component_properties
title: Set component properties
description: Sets properties of a component or a component set; currently description (shown in the inspector and on hover). Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } + description. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that is not a COMPONENT/COMPONENT_SET.

description.description: Component description; an empty string clears it

name: create_image
title: Create image
description: Creates a rectangle in a parent with an image fill from a file (PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 4096 × 4096 px), sized as the image. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). Also imageHash. NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, an index out of range; nothing is created then. INVALID_ARGUMENT also for an unreadable file or an image Figma rejects.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

name: create_paint_style
title: Create paint style
description: Creates a local paint style, optionally with paints as in set_paint_style_paints. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. INVALID_ARGUMENT if a paint style already has the name or a paint is invalid; NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable; nothing is created then.

color.description: "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } of a COLOR variable

angle.description: CSS angle in degrees: 0 — to top, 90 — to right, 180 — to bottom

center.description: Ellipse center in fractions of the box (0.5, 0.5 — middle)

radius.description: Half-axes in fractions of the box (0.5, 0.5 — touches the edges)

paints.description: Paints in Figma array order: the LAST one is on top (top of the Figma panel), paints[0] at the bottom; visible, opacity 1, blendMode NORMAL

name: create_svg
title: Create SVG
description: Creates a frame of vectors from an SVG file (createNodeFromSvg) in a parent. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, an index out of range; nothing is created then. INVALID_ARGUMENT also for an unreadable file or SVG Figma cannot read.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

name: create_text
title: Create text
description: Creates a TEXT layer in a parent with the given text in Inter Regular (the font is loaded first). Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). NOT_FOUND for an unknown parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a parent that cannot have children, an instance or a layer inside one, an index out of range; nothing is created then.

parentId.description: Parent id: a page or a layer with children (frame, group, …)

index.description: Place among the parent's children; end by default

x.description: X in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

y.description: Y in the parent (a page or a frame without auto layout)

name: create_text_style
title: Create text style
description: Creates a local text style with a font and optional size, line height and letter spacing; fields left out keep the Figma default. Values are plain (not bound) — bind variables with set_text_style_variable. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. INVALID_ARGUMENT if a text style already has the name, the font is not available in Figma or a value is invalid; nothing is created then.

style.description: Font style as the font names it, e.g. "Regular", "Semi Bold"

fontName.description: Font family + style; must be available in Figma (get_available_fonts)

name: create_variable
title: Create variable
description: Creates a variable in a local collection. values maps mode id → value (primitive or alias); modes left out keep the Figma default. All values are checked before anything is created. Returns the variable as in get_variable. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection or alias target; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the name is taken in the collection, a mode is not in it, or a value does not match the type.

id.description: Id of the variable to alias

additionalProperties.description: COLOR: "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa"; FLOAT: number; STRING: string; BOOLEAN: true/false; or an alias { type: "VARIABLE_ALIAS", id } to a variable of the same type

name: create_variable_collection
title: Create variable collection
description: Creates a local variable collection. modes lists mode names in order: the first one names the mode created with the collection and becomes its default mode for good (Figma cannot change the default mode later). Without modes the collection gets one mode named by Figma. Returns the collection as in get_variable_collections.

modes.description: Mode names; the first becomes the default mode

name: delete_node
title: Delete node
description: Deletes a layer with all its children. Returns { id, name, type } of the deleted layer. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page or a layer inside an instance.

name: delete_style
title: Delete style
description: Deletes a local style of any kind. Nodes that use it keep their values and lose the link to the style. Returns { id, type, name } of the deleted style; NOT_FOUND for an unknown style.

name: delete_variable
title: Delete variable
description: Deletes a local variable. Returns { id, name, collectionId } of the deleted variable; NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable.

name: delete_variable_collection
title: Delete variable collection
description: Deletes a local variable collection together with all its variables. Returns { id, name, deletedVariableCount }; NOT_FOUND if there is no local collection with this id.

name: delete_variable_group
title: Delete variable group
description: Deletes all variables of a group in one local collection. Returns { collectionId, group, deleted [{ id, name }] }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection or group.

name: delete_variable_mode
title: Delete variable mode
description: Deletes a mode of a local variable collection together with the values of all variables in it. Returns the collection as in get_variable_collections. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the mode is not in this collection or is its only mode.

name: export_node_png
title: Export node as PNG
description: Exports a snapshot of a node as PNG (exportAsync PNG, constraint SCALE) and writes it to outFile. Returns { savedTo, bytes, id, name, format, scale }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that cannot be exported or a bad scale.

scale.description: Scale: 1 — as in the layout, 2 — twice as large

outFile.description: The .png file to write (absolute path recommended)

name: export_node_svg
title: Export node as SVG
description: Exports a node as SVG code (exportAsync SVG_STRING; Figma defaults: text as outlines, no id attributes, simplified strokes) and writes it to outFile. Returns { savedTo, bytes, id, name, format }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that cannot be exported.

outFile.description: The .svg file to write (absolute path recommended)

name: get_available_fonts
title: Get available fonts
description: Lists the fonts available in Figma (as in the font picker): [{ family, styles: ["Regular", "Semi Bold", …] }]. The list is long — pass outFile.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_local_styles
title: Get local styles
description: Lists all local styles of the open Figma file in panel order, kinds TEXT, EFFECT, PAINT, GRID: id, type, name and the fields of the kind. TEXT: fontName { family, style }, fontSize, lineHeight and letterSpacing ({ unit: "PIXELS" | "PERCENT", value } or { unit: "AUTO" }), textCase, textDecoration, paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent, boundVariables { field: { type: "VARIABLE_ALIAS", id, alias, aliasCollection } }. EFFECT: effects; PAINT: paints; GRID: layoutGrids — as Figma gives them, colors as lowercase hex, bound variables in alias form. With outFile the list goes to that file — use it for bulk reads.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_local_variables
title: Get local variables
description: Lists all local variables of the open Figma file: id, name, type, collectionId, collection and values [{ modeId, mode, value }], codeSyntax { WEB?, ANDROID?, iOS? } (only the platforms that are set, scopes — where it is offered in Figma pickers, [] = hidden; e.g. { WEB: "--color-primary" }). COLOR values are lowercase hex (#rrggbb, #rrggbbaa with transparency). An alias value is { type: "VARIABLE_ALIAS", id, alias, aliasCollection } — alias is the target variable name, aliasCollection its collection name (both null if the target no longer exists). With outFile the list goes to that file — use it for bulk reads.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_node_css
title: Get node CSS
description: Returns the CSS of a node and of every layer under it, as the Dev Mode inspect panel shows it (getCSSAsync): { nodes: [{ id, name, type, parentId, css: { property: value } }] } in tree order. The data is large — pass outFile. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_node_tree
title: Get node tree
description: Returns the whole subtree of a node in the Figma REST API format (exportAsync JSON_REST_V1, as GET /v1/files): { document, components, componentSets, styles, … }; document holds the node with all its children and fields (characters and style overrides of texts, fills with imageRef, componentId, boundVariables, …). The data is large — pass outFile. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that cannot be exported.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_selection
title: Get selection
description: Returns the selection on the current Figma page: { page: { id, name }, nodes: [{ id, name, type, top }] } — top { id, name, type }: the layer's ancestor right under the page (the layout frame), the layer itself if it lies on the page. Nothing selected — nodes is empty.

name: get_status
title: Get connection status
description: Checks the Claude Code → MCP server → Figma plugin link. On success returns server { port, label, labelSource: default|set, env: desktop|cli }, plugin state and the name of the file open in Figma. Otherwise returns an error { code, message, server } with code PORT_IN_USE, PLUGIN_NOT_CONNECTED or TIMEOUT. Call it before working with Figma; labelSource "default" → name the session with set_session_label first.

name: get_variable
title: Get variable
description: Returns one variable by id in the same format as get_local_variables items. Returns NOT_FOUND if there is no variable with this id.

name: get_variable_collections
title: Get variable collections
description: Lists local variable collections of the open Figma file: id, name, modes [{ id, name }], defaultModeId and variableCount. With outFile the list goes to that file.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: get_variable_groups
title: Get variable groups
description: Lists variable groups of one local collection with the number of variables in each. A group is the name prefix before the last "/" ("colors/blue-400" → "colors"); variables without "/" are counted under the group "". Returns NOT_FOUND if there is no local collection with this id. With outFile the result goes to that file.

outFile.description: Write the result as JSON to this file (absolute path recommended) and return only { savedTo, count }

name: group_nodes
title: Group nodes
description: Wraps layers of one parent in a new group (figma.group). The layers keep their place on screen and their own order; the group takes the stack place index (among the parent's children after grouping), by default the place of the topmost of them. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height, children }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown layer; INVALID_ARGUMENT for an empty or repeating list, layers of different parents, a page, a layer inside an instance, an index out of range; nothing is changed then.

ids.description: Ids of the layers to group, all of one parent

index.description: Place of the group among the parent's children after grouping; default — the place of the topmost layer

name: move_node
title: Move node
description: Moves a layer into a parent (the same or another) at a place among its children; index is the place after the move, the end by default. The id is kept. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). NOT_FOUND for an unknown node or parent; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page, a parent that cannot have children, an index out of range, a move into the layer itself or its child, a layer or parent inside an instance.

parentId.description: New parent id: a page or a layer with children

index.description: Place among the parent's children after the move; end by default

name: move_style
title: Move style
description: Moves a local style of any kind right after another local style of the same kind, or first with afterId null (the order of the styles panel and of get_local_styles). Returns { id, type, name, order } — order is the names of that kind after the move. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the styles are of different kinds.

afterId.description: Id of the style to put it after, or null to put it first

name: rename_node
title: Rename node
description: Renames a layer; its id is kept. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, index, x, y, width, height } (+ characters for text). NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a page.

name: rename_style
title: Rename style
description: Renames a local style of any kind; its id and the nodes using it are kept. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style; INVALID_ARGUMENT if a style of the same kind already has the name.

name: rename_variable
title: Rename variable
description: Renames a local variable; its id and the bindings in the file are kept. Returns the variable as in get_variable. NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the name is taken in its collection.

name: rename_variable_collection
title: Rename variable collection
description: Renames a local variable collection. Returns the collection as in get_variable_collections; NOT_FOUND if there is no local collection with this id.

name: rename_variable_group
title: Rename variable group
description: Renames a group of one local collection: every variable "<group>/<name>" becomes "<new name>/<name>". Returns { collectionId, group, variables [{ id, name }] }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection or group; INVALID_ARGUMENT if any new name is taken — then nothing is renamed.

group.description: Current group name, as in get_variable_groups

name: rename_variable_mode
title: Rename variable mode
description: Renames a mode of a local variable collection. Returns the collection as in get_variable_collections. NOT_FOUND for an unknown collection; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the mode is not in this collection or the name is taken.

name: replace_with_svg
title: Replace with SVG
description: Replaces a node with a frame of vectors made from an SVG file (createNodeFromSvg). The frame takes the node's parent, place among the children, x / y, size, name, constraints and auto-layout settings; the old node is removed. The new node has a NEW id: returns { id, oldId, name, width, height }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node inside an instance, a page, an unreadable file or SVG Figma cannot read.

name: set_effect_style_effects
title: Set effect style effects
description: Replaces the whole effects list of a local effect style with shadows (DROP_SHADOW / INNER_SHADOW: color, x, y, radius, spread) and normal blurs (LAYER_BLUR / BACKGROUND_BLUR: radius; progressive blurs are not supported). Each field is a plain value or { variableId } — bound to that variable; variable types are checked before writing (color — COLOR, the rest — FLOAT). Figma effects are immutable, so the list is set as a whole. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style or variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT if it is not an effect style or an effect is invalid.

color.description: "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } of a COLOR variable

x.description: Offset x in px or { variableId } of a FLOAT variable

y.description: Offset y in px or { variableId }

radius.description: Blur radius in px (>= 0) or { variableId }
Blur radius in Figma units (>= 0; CSS blur() is half of it) or { variableId } of a FLOAT variable

effects.description: Shadows and normal blurs in Figma array order: the LAST one is on top (top of the Figma panel); shadows get blendMode NORMAL, showShadowBehindNode false

name: set_image_fill
title: Set image fill
description: Puts an image file (PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 4096 × 4096 px) into the visible image fill of a node; the fill keeps its scale mode and other settings. Returns { id, name, imageHash, fillIndex }. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node without a visible image fill, an unreadable file or an image Figma rejects.

name: set_paint_style_paints
title: Set paint style paints
description: Replaces the whole paints list of a local paint style: SOLID { color }, GRADIENT_LINEAR { angle, stops }, GRADIENT_RADIAL { center, radius, stops }. Colors are plain or { variableId } — bound to that COLOR variable (solid color or gradient stop). Geometry is given in CSS terms for a square box; the plugin builds gradientTransform. Bindings are read back; if Figma drops one, the style is restored and INVALID_ARGUMENT returned. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style or variable.

color.description: "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbaa" or { variableId } of a COLOR variable

angle.description: CSS angle in degrees: 0 — to top, 90 — to right, 180 — to bottom

center.description: Ellipse center in fractions of the box (0.5, 0.5 — middle)

radius.description: Half-axes in fractions of the box (0.5, 0.5 — touches the edges)

paints.description: Paints in Figma array order: the LAST one is on top (top of the Figma panel), paints[0] at the bottom; visible, opacity 1, blendMode NORMAL

name: set_session_label
title: Set session label
description: Sets the label of this Claude session in the session list of the FrontMultitool Bridge plugin (Desktop: the Desktop session title; terminal: a name for the session's task). Does not need the plugin. Returns { port, label, labelSource }.

name: set_text
title: Set text
description: Replaces the text of a TEXT node; the fonts of the node are loaded first. Returns { id, name, characters, mixed } — mixed: the old text had several looks (font, size, color, …) and the new one has the look Figma gives it. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that is not TEXT or uses a missing font.

name: set_text_style_properties
title: Set text style properties
description: Sets plain values of a local text style: any of fontName, fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing; fields left out are not changed. Returns the style as in get_local_styles. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style; INVALID_ARGUMENT if it is not a text style, the font is not available in Figma or a value is invalid.

style.description: Font style as the font names it, e.g. "Regular", "Semi Bold"

fontName.description: Font family + style; must be available in Figma (get_available_fonts)

name: set_text_style_variable
title: Set text style variable
description: Binds a field of a local text style to a variable, or removes the binding with variableId null. fontFamily needs a STRING variable whose value is a font available in Figma with the current font style; fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing need FLOAT (pixels). Returns the style as in get_local_styles. NOT_FOUND for an unknown style or variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a wrong variable type or a missing font.

variableId.description: Variable id, or null to unbind

name: set_variable_code_syntax
title: Set variable code syntax
description: Sets the code syntax of a local variable for one platform (WEB by default) — for WEB the CSS custom property name, e.g. "--color-primary". Returns the variable as in get_variable; NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable.

name: set_variable_scopes
title: Set variable scopes
description: Sets the scopes of a local variable — the fields whose variable pickers in the Figma interface offer it. [] hides it from all pickers; other variables can still alias it and the API can still bind it. ALL_SCOPES cannot be combined with others; scopes must suit the type (FLOAT, STRING, COLOR). Returns the variable as in get_variable. NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a scope that does not apply or if Figma did not keep the scopes.

name: set_variable_value
title: Set variable value
description: Sets the value of a local variable in one mode: a primitive or an alias. Returns the variable as in get_variable. NOT_FOUND for an unknown variable or alias target; INVALID_ARGUMENT if the mode is not in the variable's collection or the value does not match the type.

id.description: Id of the variable to alias

value.description: COLOR: "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa"; FLOAT: number; STRING: string; BOOLEAN: true/false; or an alias { type: "VARIABLE_ALIAS", id } to a variable of the same type

name: ungroup_node
title: Ungroup node
description: Removes a group or frame (figma.ungroup): its children go to its parent at its place. Returns { id, name, type, parentId, lostStyle, children } — lostStyle: the frame had visible fills, strokes or effects, and that look is gone. NOT_FOUND for an unknown node; INVALID_ARGUMENT for a node that is not a group or frame, has no children or is inside an instance.

name: run_batch
title: Run batch of tool calls
description: Runs calls of the other figmabridge tools listed in a JSON file, in order, and returns a short summary instead of every result. File: { "ops": [{ "tool", "args", "saves"? }] }. saves maps a placeholder to a path in that step's result ({ "$var:--color-red": "id" }, { "$mode:Themes/dark": "modes[1].id" }); later args (values and keys) equal to the placeholder get the saved value. Arguments of all steps are checked against their tools before the first call. Stops at the first failing step: error { code, message, step, done, total } — steps before it are applied (no rollback). outFile gets every step's result.

outFile.description: Write the results of all steps to this file
